title: Exact (2^d - 1) CNOT Parity Phase-Gadget Synthesis of Degree-d Carry Monomials
claims: Over the integers Z, every degree-d binary product satisfies 2^{d-1} prod_{j=1}^d u_j = sum_{emptyset != S subseteq {1..d}} (-1)^{|S|-1} ((+)_{j in S} u_j) across all u in {0, 1}^d.

Consequently, the d-body controlled-Z carry gate C^{d-1}Z decomposes into exactly 2^d - 1 single-qubit rotations of angle +/- pi / 2^{d-1} conjugated by CNOT parity trees (3 S-gadgets for CZ, 7 T-gadgets for CCZ, 15 pi/8-gadgets for C^3Z).
